description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 11.05.2015 to 15.05.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs operations, which falls squarely under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
